title: The romance of the classic red rose
body: Roses have long symbolized love and passion, with their layered petals and rich fragrance making them the centerpiece of romantic bouquets for centuries.

title: Why peonies are a spring garden favorite
body: Peonies bloom in late spring with lush, ruffled petals in soft pinks and whites, prized by gardeners for their full, rounded blossoms.

title: Sunflowers and how they track the sun
body: Sunflowers are known for heliotropism, tilting their large yellow heads to follow the sun's path across the sky throughout the day.

title: Growing tulips from bulbs this fall
body: Tulip bulbs should be planted in autumn for a colorful spring display, with cup-shaped blooms in reds, yellows, and purples.

title: The humble daisy in cottage gardens
body: Daisies are simple, cheerful flowers with white petals surrounding a yellow center, often naturalized in lawns and cottage-style borders.

title: Five budgeting tips for freelancers
body: Freelance income is unpredictable, so setting aside a percentage of every invoice, tracking quarterly taxes, and building a cash buffer are essential habits.
